create_open_platypus_dataset: create an OpenPlatypusDataset instance with dataset args, split, and processor for the garage-bAInd/Open-Platypus dataset
register_open_platypus_dataset: register the OpenPlatypusDataset class as a text generation dataset named open_platypus
build_alpaca_prompt_input: build an Alpaca-style prompt with instruction and input fields using the prompt_input template
build_alpaca_prompt_no_input: build an Alpaca-style prompt with only an instruction field using the prompt_no_input template
run_dataset_template: run dataset_template on a sample to produce text and prompt keys with formatted Alpaca output
